title: A Debt for the Protocol
author: Sable Crane
blurb: Oscar Amberdale, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
